name: Infollion
description: Infollion connects you to its curated network of subject-matter experts, independent consultants, and freelancers. Just describe the expertise you need - by skills, industry, role, company, or geography - and get back the most relevant expert profiles. When you find the right person, request a consultation and Infollion's team arranges the introduction. Trusted by companies, consulting firms, and investment funds for exploratory research, due diligence, benchmarking, and hypothesis validation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Infollion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Infollion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.infollion.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Infollion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Infollion provides these MCP tools: connect_to_expert, describe_value_chain, discover_experts, find_value_chains_for_experts, focus_value_chain_node, open_value_chain_by_cluster, search_value_chains, and zoom_value_chain.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Infollion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Infollion in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Infollion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Infollion is developed by INFOLLION RESEARCH SERVICES LIMITED. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
